services.name: NYC Ultimate Experience Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: Circle the Entire Island of Manhattan! Duration 2.5 Hours About For the Ultimate Scenic Experience we will embrace on a trip circling the entire island of Manhattan! We will begin the tour by passing under the Verrazano Bridge, continuing up the narrows, passing Governors Island. Once we get to Manhattan we will continue up the East River passing through Manhattan and Roosevelt Island. We will continue into the Harlem River which has the calmest water in all of NYC, then pass under the Henry Hudson Bridge into the Hudson River.
